arguments.text: Stay on their wash, close the gap, then steady.

arguments.message: pod reserve below 35 pct while still on the wash: time to let go and settle near critical power
wash benefit gone: paddler has dropped off the pack

text: hang_on: the wash saves about a tenth of drag at 159 W; hold it now and let go before the pod reserve runs low (watch set at 35 pct).

arguments.message: pod reserve runs out well before the finish at this shaft power

text: no cue: alarm came from the boat-model reserve; pod effort 153 W is near the sustainable 151 W, rewrote over_pace to use the pod reserve.

arguments.text: Let the pack go. Settle into your own steady pace.

text: let_go: wash benefit has faded to near zero while shaft power 157 W sits above the sustainable 151 W; chasing would empty the pod reserve at about 3.2 km.

arguments.text: Ease a touch, long smooth strokes, hold 1:50.

text: no cue: an ease cue was blocked by the 60 s spacing; a cue went out 15 s ago and shaft power is already starting to fall toward the sustainable 151 W.

arguments.text: Ease a little, settle smooth, hold 1:50 pace.

text: ease to 1:50: shaft power 155-158 W against a sustainable 151 W empties the pod reserve at about 2.5 km of 4.8 km left; off the wash now.

arguments.text: Ease a little, smooth and steady, hold 1:50.

text: no cue: ease cue blocked, a cue went out 13 s ago; let it take effect.

arguments.reason: boat power held 118-124 W for 7 min with the boat reserve empty and no fade (fade near 0); boat test value 92 W is low. Shaft value left at 143 W: pod reserve not yet near empty, no evidence.

arguments.text: Ease slightly. Steady effort, not pace, into this current.

text: ease (no pace target into the current): shaft 155-158 W stays above the sustainable 150 W and empties the pod reserve near 2.8 km of 4.4 km left; raised boat CP to 118 W as the boat reserve read empty with no fade.

arguments.text: Back off now, a tenth easier. Long relaxed strokes.

text: ease: shaft power has crept from 158 to 165 W for the same boat speed; pod reserve 29 pct empties in about 700 m of 3550 m left, sustainable is 147 W.

arguments.text: Ease off a tenth now. Relaxed, long strokes.

text: no cue: ease cue blocked, one went out 18 s ago; shaft power already starting down from 165 W.
no cue: shaft power has come down to 147 W, within 2 W of the sustainable 145 W; the paddler responded, leave them to settle.

arguments.text: Drop the rate two. Longer, cleaner strokes, same effort.

text: rate_down: speed through the water has faded 5 pct at the same rate while shaft power held near 149 W; tired paddler, best rate is now lower.

arguments.message: shaft power more than 4 pct above the pod-sustainable level

text: no cue: shaft power 147 W is within 2 W of the sustainable 145 W and speed is steady; rewrote over_pace to need a 4 pct excess.

arguments.text: Turn done, ease back to steady. Save it for the finish.

text: ease: shaft power rose to 154 W against a sustainable 145 W with only 8 pct pod reserve left; at this power it empties in about 360 m of 2250 m.

arguments.text: Ease back to steady now. Save it for the finish.

text: no cue: ease blocked, one went out 22 s ago; give it time to take effect.

arguments.text: Ease off now, you are on the limit. Smooth and long.

text: ease: pod reserve is at 0.6 pct with 1.8 km left and shaft power 151 W sits 8 W above sustainable; avoid the forced slowdown of running empty.

arguments.reason: shaft power held 145-150 W for about 10 min, the last 5 min with the pod reserve reading empty, and speed and fade steady (no further decline); test value 143 W is low.

text: no cue: steady at 148 W with speed holding at 1 km to go; raised shaft CP to 148 W since the empty pod reserve has not forced a slowdown; sprint comes later.
no cue: turn into the last leg, effort steady at critical power; too early for the sprint at 978 m.

arguments.text: Settle a touch, strong and long. Full sprint soon.

arguments.message: about 330 m to go: start the final sprint

text: ease slightly: a 192 W sprint from 560 m with the pod reserve reading empty risks blowing up before the line; full sprint cue set for about 330 m to go.

arguments.text: Go now. Everything to the line.

text: finish: 324 m to go, about 100 s of sprinting; spend whatever is left.
no cue: 19 m to go, inside the last 100 m.
